status: FROZEN_SEMANTICS — capability not yet qualified, historical Y not exposed

inherited_unchanged.weights: w_sb = treated_n_sb / total treated, identical to V1
inherited_unchanged.note: nothing about which episodes are comparable to which changes. Only the function that turns a block contrast into a number changes.

effect_size.role: ECONOMIC MAGNITUDE ONLY — never a promotion criterion

selection_statistic.null_moments: E_0[U_sb] = 1/2 exactly; Var_0(U_sb) = [ (N+1) - sum(t^3-t)/(N(N-1)) ] / (12 n_t n_c), N = n_t + n_c, tie groups t from the block's own Y multiset
selection_statistic.variance: V_s = sum_b w_sb^2 Var_0(U_sb) — blocks independent under within-block permutation
selection_statistic.denominator_rule: REGISTERED ONCE from the frozen population. Never re-estimated per delta, per world, or from an injected vector — all deltas must share one calibrated ruler.
selection_statistic.moments_verified: exact against exhaustive enumeration, with and without ties

multiplicity.statistic: max_s Z_rank_s over all k=840 claims
multiplicity.mapping: one permutation mapping applied to all 840 claims simultaneously, so the dependence among claims is carried by the null rather than modelled

promotion_rule.rule: observed Z_rank_s > registered p95( max-null Z_rank )
promotion_rule.theta_cannot_rescue: a large raw theta on a claim whose Z_rank does not clear the band is NOT an alternative route to promotion
promotion_rule.no_second_chance: no per-family, per-support or step-down variant may be substituted after seeing the result

injection_semantics.rule: delta is injected on the RAW outcome, never on U or R
injection_semantics.path: base null world -> Y_delta = Y + delta * needle_membership -> recompute within-block midranks -> Z_rank[840]
injection_semantics.why: adding an artificial effect directly to the bounded score would measure sensitivity to rank displacement, not to an MFE effect in percentage points, and the delta grid would stop meaning pp
injection_semantics.band_per_delta: the injection enters the inner-null world, so each delta carries its own band — identical to frozen V1 capability semantics

reporting_contract.uncertainty_on_theta: descriptive bootstrap interval, EXPLICITLY NOT a selection-adjusted 95% interval. A claim chosen by the rank statistic has no post-selection coverage guarantee unless a simultaneous or selective interval is separately built.
reporting_contract.two_columns: evidence_rank (by Z_rank) and effect_size (theta pp) are reported as SEPARATE columns. Silent substitution of one for the other is a reporting defect.

variance_decomposition.finding: block tail scale separates raw-max dominators; weight and arm geometry do not

supporting_diagnostics.status: NULL GEOMETRY ONLY — these qualify the instrument, not its power

delta_grid_rationale: identical to V1 so V1 and V2 sensitivity are directly comparable
forbidden_claims: the rank statistic is more powerful (a lower band is not more power; the numerator changed too)
V1's estimand was wrong (only its decision statistic failed)
T5 sequence miner is well powered
y_status: HISTORICAL RANKING NOT COMPUTED, NOT EXPOSED
